prompt:
Scene:
A top-down square photograph of a pastel-pink scrapbook spread on a patterned tablecloth. Warm overhead party light glows across the page, catching scattered glitter and a few crumbs of confetti near the seam. The paper carries a slight crinkle from being open for hours.

Subject:
A birthday memory spread full of joyful clutter. The left page carries a paper party hat flattened with tape, a handwritten invitation stuck with patterned washi, a small photo-booth strip clipped with a tiny pink clothes pin, and a swirl of hand-drawn candles with uneven flames. The right page shows a big sticker-letter banner spelling a non-literal cluster of shapes, several mismatched cake stickers, a ballpoint-scribbled list with shaky bullet points, and a sugar-dust smear near the bottom.

Important details:
Glitter must have actual small reflective dots catching light from different angles. Confetti pieces are tiny physical paper circles, each casting its own tiny shadow. The sticker-letter banner's letters are deliberately irregular — some crooked, some at wrong angles, some peeling. Handwriting is energetic and uneven, the bullet points drift in size. Palette: pastel pink, butter yellow, mint, coral.

Use case:
Independent single image in the Scrapbook Variations package, representing the celebratory family voice.

Constraints:
No readable text, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no vector-perfect banner, no uniform gradient, no AI-style cake realism, preserve exact 1:1 aspect ratio.
title: Birthday Memory Sheet
description: A joyful birthday scrapbook spread with party hat, glitter, photo-booth strip, and a wobbly sticker banner.

generation.runner_notes: Independent single image; no reference required.
